title: Offset
text: Truncate vectors by removing or keeping beginning or ending values, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Action for out of range offset value} sets Action for out of range offset value; {Mode} sets the which values to discard and which values to keep Remove beginning, {Number of input data-offset pairs}, {Output port length} sets the mode to specify output port length Same and {Output length} sets the desired length of output vectors. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Mode
params.values: Specify which values to discard and which values to keep Remove beginning samples (default) | Remove ending samples | Keep beginning samples | Keep ending samples

params.name: Number of input data-offset pairs
params.values: Number of input data-offset pairs 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output port length
params.values: Mode to specify output port length Same as input (default) | User-defined

params.name: Output length
params.values: Desired length of output vectors 9 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Action for out of range offset value
params.values: Action for out of range offset value Clip (default) | Clip and warn | Error
